description: Sara Carter article (March 21, 2018): 'New Text Msgs Reveal FBI Agent was Friends with Judge in Flynn Case' — header photo of Lisa Page and Peter Strzok; lede: newly redacted texts show the FBI agent at the center of the Russia probe was close friends with the DC judge who recused himself from the Michael Flynn case.
text: National Security. Politics. New Text Msgs Reveal FBI Agent was Friends with Judge in Flynn Case. Congressional members say DOJ stonewalling information on FBI texts. Sara Carter. March 21, 2018. 193,164. Newly redacted text messages discovered by congressional investigators reveal that an embattled FBI agent at the center of the Russia investigation controversy was close friends with a District of Columbia judge who recused himself from the criminal case over former National Security Advisor Michael Flynn, congressional members said, and text documents show.
